content.content: The applied prefix is markers[..pos], the redo tail markers[pos..]. Markers reveal the order operations ran in.
content.rationale: The linear history (kpptprql) splits the marker list at the position: the applied prefix before it and the undone tail from it onward, so order is visible from the markers alone. Fixing order-visibility here keeps both the refused and the re-applied operation fed without teaching markers about the verbs.
